visual_action: A montage of two clips featuring Donald and Melania Trump interacting with children in Halloween costumes. In one clip, a child wears a large, glowing, cylindrical headpiece. In the other, a child wears an inflatable Minion costume. The video has a hazy, dream-like visual filter.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is visually present in every clip, interacting with children in costume. His presence is confirmed by face-ID.

cast.name: Melania Trump
cast.evidence: Melania Trump appears alongside Donald Trump in the video clips.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account.

on_screen_text.text: I KNOW YOU GET DÉJÀ VU

spoken_summary: The video features lyrics from Olivia Rodrigo's song "deja vu" being sung: "a different girl now, but there's nothing new... I know you get déjà vu."
audio_music: The soundtrack is Olivia Rodrigo's song "deja vu," which plays consistently throughout the video. The pop song's melancholic and reflective tone is used to create an ironic and mocking effect when paired with footage of Donald Trump.
editing_pacing: The video is a short, slow-paced montage of two clips that repeat. A hazy, soft-focus filter is applied over the footage.
cultural_references: The song "deja vu" by Olivia Rodrigo is used as the soundtrack and its lyrics are displayed on screen.
A child is shown wearing an inflatable Minion costume, referencing the character from the 'Despicable Me' movie franchise.
central_claim: A potential second Donald Trump presidency would be an unwelcome and predictable repetition of his first term, like a bad 'déjà vu'.
intended_effect: To make the viewer, particularly younger audiences familiar with the song, feel that a return of Donald Trump to the presidency would be a tiresome and negative repeat of the past.
